text_block_list.text:
Invited by Grass Wonder,
I ended up helping with the harvest in the fields.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Phew... I guess that's about it. We harvested a lot of vegetables, didn't we~?
choice_data_list: Why do field work all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I've been getting interested in vegetarian Buddhist cuisine lately.
My diet's been messed up, and I think I gained some weight...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So, I thought I'd use the vegetables here, and got permission to harvest from the field.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Changing your diet to purge worldly desires...
Japanese culture is truly wonderful, isn't it~♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu, let's start using it tonight~.
Later on, Grass Wonder happily mentioned that it also helped with her diet.
